# Many Scores, Many Cancers correlations

```{r}
plotdat_scores_for_lm %>%
  filter(cancer != "KIRC") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = score)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = signature), method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~cancer, nrow = 3) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "Mitochondrial Oxygen Demand") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Signature")
ggsave("figures/Supp_3sigs_loess_facet.png",
       height = 10,
       width = 7.5)
```
